Around [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Empire" /> the [[Dulok Swamp]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]<ref name="blog question" /> was invaded and '''destroyed''' by forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The Imperials were looking for a site to build a [[Endor shield generator bunker|shield generator bunker]] to protect their [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]]. The [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]], part of a [[Gorneesh's tribe|tribe]] led by [[King/Legends|King]] [[Gorneesh/Legends|Gorneesh]], were no match for the invaders' weapons, nor for the subterranean creature awakened by the commotion: the [[Griagh]]. After their victory, the Imperial forces [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] the Duloks.<ref name="SOE 11-2" />
